A_onsets.changepoint: two-segment least-squares fit of log close over [breach-240, breach]; break minimising total SSE with both segments >= 10 min, second slope negative and below the first; fallback to the 1% onset if no admissible break
A_onsets.peak: argmax close in the 240 min before the breach (catalog peak); pre = alert before the peak
A_onsets.per_minute: notebook-18 L1 decomposition with the in-decline split at each onset

B_positioning.causality: metrics usable 5 min after create_time (stale after 30 min); funding usable 1 min after calc_time (stale after 720 min)
B_positioning.comparison_mask: per-minute comparisons use minutes where all positioning features exist

models.P3_GBM_positioning: notebook-16 GBM settings on FEATS + positioning

B_positioning.protocol_rule: if positioning features cover >= 95% of valid 2021 minutes: train 2021, calibrate 2022 (240 alerts); else train 2022-01..06, calibrate 2022-07..12 (120 alerts, 20/month); evaluation 2023-01..2026-04 with 240/yr, 20/month
B_positioning.source: Binance USD-M futures BTCUSDT daily metrics (5-min open interest, top-trader and account long/short ratios, taker long/short volume ratio) and monthly funding-rate archives; SHA-256 checked when a .CHECKSUM is published
B_positioning.z_scores: trailing 30 days, min 15 days, shifted one minute

C_volatility.V1_GJR_GARCH_t: 5-min log returns, GJR-GARCH(1,1) Student-t fitted by ML on 2021; score = P(4h return <= ln 0.96) from the aggregated 48-bar variance forecast (t approximation)
C_volatility.V2_GARCH_drawdown: same variance; score = P(4h return <= ln(0.96 / (1 - current drawdown from the trailing-240-min high)))
C_volatility.V3_HAR_RV: OLS on 2021 of log next-4h realised variance on log 1h, 4h, 1d, 1w realised variance (5-min bars)
C_volatility.causality: minute t uses the last completed 5-min bar
